corrections.reason: In Col 1 L27, the printed glyph is 4th order 'ባ' ('ባገኝባት' = 'if I find in her'), where the shorter right leg of 'ባ' was misread as 1st order 'በ'.
In Col 2 L05, the printed word is 'በዝር' (6th order ር, meaning leftover/late-hanging fig), not 'በዝረ'.
In Col 2 L06, the image clearly shows the right-side horizontal stroke of 2nd order 'ቁ' ('ያው ቁሉ', standard Andemta expression for 'even taking the word literally / the literal question itself').
In Col 2 L22, the printed glyph is 4th order 'ባ' ('ባገኝባቸው' = 'if I find in them'), misread as 1st order 'በ'.
In Col 2 L29-30, the text reads 'ያን ጊዜ ደግ ሰው ጠፋ' ('at that time good men vanished'). The 1st order 'ሰ' at the start of L30 was misread as 'ሷ'.
In Col 3 L01, the printed word is 'ባንቺ' (4th order 'ባ', 'in you'), misread as 'በንቺ'.
In Col 3 L14-15, the printed word across the line wrap is 'ባን↵ቺ' (4th order 'ባ'), misread as 'በን↵ቺ'.
In Col 3 L30, both the image and canonical Ge'ez Matthew 21:21 read 6th order 'ዕፅ' ('አኮ ከመ ዕፅ ባሕቲቶ ዘትገብሩ'), not 1st order 'ዕፀ'.

In Col 3 L32-33, the traditional Andemta idiom for a mustard seed (citing Matt 17:20) is 'በቅድል ጠሩ' ('a single grain of mustard seed', where ቅድል = ቅንጣት/አብሽ/ሰናፍጭ). Visually in L32 the glyph after 'በቅ' is 'ድ' ('በቅድል'), not 'ጠ'.
